subject: Nate Merritt Candidate Profile
overview: City Council candidate Nate Merritt outlined his platform for the 2025 Medford municipal election, emphasizing local infrastructure, public safety, and support for single-family homeowners.

items.title: Nate Merritt Candidate Profile
items.summary: Candidate Nate Merritt presented his platform for Medford City Council, advocating for local infrastructure improvements, support for seniors and single-family homeowners, and increased public safety staffing while criticizing the current council's focus on national issues and zoning changes.
